name: pulse
description: Connect Codex to Pulse: one sign-in, and the folder with each project's code is connected to its Pulse project. Pulse records which skills, tools and model your assistant uses and how many tokens, never your conversations or code. Every hour your assistant writes a short session report in the background. Your project managers can read it. Also loads your project's Pulse skills and the Pulse tools for daily updates and changelogs.

interface.shortDescription: Connect the folder with your project's code to Pulse
interface.longDescription: Signs in to Pulse once per computer and connects the folder with each project's code to its Pulse project. Pulse records which skills, tools and model your assistant uses and how many tokens, never your conversations or code. Every hour your assistant writes a short session report in the background. Your project managers can read it. Loads the skills of your Pulse projects and includes the Pulse tools for daily updates and changelogs: no separate connector needed.
interface.defaultPrompt: Show my Pulse status for this folder.
